title: AARO SCIF briefing showing only resolved cases

tellings.quote: literally a slideshow of we looked into this and this was a dead like here's what it was, right? This was a balloon.

plain: In 2023, the Pentagon office set up to look into unexplained flying objects gave lawmakers a briefing in a secure room for classified material, and it showed only cases it had already solved, such as one that turned out to be a balloon. Congressman Eric Burlison, who was there, describes it as literally a slideshow of 'we looked into this and here's what it was.' He names the office's leaders, Sean Kirkpatrick and Jon Kosloski, and tells it to suggest the briefing left out the cases that still have no explanation.
